messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick lightweight ask for launch assets  need a compact bench sanity pack we can cite in the blog + a single-slide stat for the webinar. Can runtime run a reproducible mini-protocol?

zoe_marketing: Specs: 400 anonymized samples stratified by token length (short/med/long), run fp16 + int8, measure gen p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and est cost per 1M tokens. Include embed p95 for med slice and one demo trace showing end-to-end embed+generate rerank. Coldstart vs warmed (warm = 3 per-worker warmups).

ryan_runtime: Yep. Two clarifiers: (1) which model names should we cite? (2) staging or prod runs?

zoe_marketing: Use redwood-v1-base for gen and redwood-embed-english-v1 for embed. Staging is fine but add GPU note. Use anonymized sampled inputs.

elsa_eng-runtime: Running on staging (A10g). Plan: 3 repeats per variant, pod restart for coldstart, warm = 3 warmups per worker. We'll include runner config, seed list, and raw traces.

deploy-bot: Job created: bench-2087654321 queued on staging at 2025-09-10T13:20:00Z. id: bench-2087654321.

ryan_runtime: Coldstart sweep done (prelim): gen p95 fp16 = 305ms(short), 525ms(med), 1290ms(long). int8 shows ~12% lower p95 on med. No OOMs.

cam_marketing: For the slide we want one crisp stat: exact % reduction p95 int8 vs fp16 on 256-token med slice. Can you include that micro-run?

ryan_runtime: Micro-run (256-token med slice), median of 3: fp16 p95 = 518ms, int8 p95 = 455ms -> ~12.1% reduction. tokens/sec fp16=228, int8=270. est cost/1M tokens fp16=$12.20, int8=$10.70 (staging rates).

nate_sales: Can you add a short note for sales: "staging numbers; prod A100-class GPUs expected to improve p95"?

elsa_eng-runtime: Added to summary. We'll upload CSV + runner-config + demo trace to s3 and paste link.

ryan_runtime: Upload complete: s3://redwood-staging/bench-2087654321/bundle.zip. CSV columns: variant, slice, run_type, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tps, est_cost_per_1M_tokens. Runner-config snippet included.

zoe_marketing: Amazing  please paste the one-line reproducibility blurb and the runner config snippet so we can paste into the post.

ryan_runtime: Blurb: "Measured on staging (A10g) with anonymized stratified inputs; reported values are medians of 3 runs. See attached traces for full reproducibility."

ryan_runtime: Runner-config snippet: "workers:6, batching.max_tokens:2048, batching.max_batch_size:24, warmup.per_worker:3, seed_file:bench-2087654321-seeds.txt, repeats:3"

zoe_marketing: Perfect  we'll draft the blog + slide and tag you for final sign-off. Thanks team! :rocket:
